newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks firm in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks firm in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks firmed in early Tuesday morning trade as investors continued to seek out issues backed by solid earnings, brokers said.
They said activity was likely to be subdued as Tuesday is the last trading day for May delivery .
As of 0019 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 80.61 points or 0.40 percent at 20,124.11. Its June futures had added 10 points to 20,160.
"The market mood is good and fundmentals also," said Shigeru Okamoto at Kankaku Securities. "It remains to be seen if turnover, which has been thin lately, increases or not."
